message: hermes compile: bare-metal target V_target may link static .a archives only; --link-static "V_lib" is not a static archive. Rebuild it as a pure C/Rust .a.
why: On bare metal the plan carries nothing but the static archives you named — no dynamic libraries, no frameworks, no loader. A path that is not a .a (a .so/.dylib, an object file, a directory) has no archive index to resolve hermes_net_* or your extern symbols against, so the link fails with an unresolved symbol far away from the real cause.
fix: rebuild it as a pure C/Rust .a (clang -c, then ar rcs)
or point --link-static at an equivalent library that already ships as an archive
